0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets (4-0) are on a four-game winning streak and sit first in the Southwest, and they lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, while the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2. Houston is without Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The Dallas Mavericks (2-2) are missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation).
